entities.description: Hezek is a large humanoid creature wearing an iron mask and a loincloth. He wields a large spiked club as his weapon and is chained to the wall by one wrist. He later forcefully tears his arm off to chase after you in his second phase. Upon defeat, he drops Hezek's Cudgel
